description: The image displays three pie charts labeled "easy," "medium," and "hard," each representing the distribution of performance across different categories for a task related to geometric knowledge reasoning with large language models. A legend on the right side of the image identifies the colors corresponding to the categories: teal for N+K+, yellow for N–K+, orange for N–K–, and red for N+K–.
